text: Very beautiful app with a seemingly well thought out (albeit completely unoriginal) idea. But I'm not going to use it. The constant pandering for money I experienced in just the first 10 minutes of opening the app made me lose all faith. Rule number one: don't treat your customers like idiots. I'm not going to even think about buying your (extremely expensive) subscription before I have any idea if it's worth my time.
